About Us

EMCOR Construction Services (ECS) is part of EMCOR Group, Inc. (NYSE: EME), a Fortune 500® leader in mechanical and electrical construction, industrial and energy infrastructure, and building services for a diverse range of businesses. ECS is a nationwide group of 50+ operating companies with over 30,000 employees and annual revenues of $10.7 billion. Our operating companies are mechanical and commercial electrical contractors with expertise that includes virtually all U.S. commercial, healthcare, institutional, education, hospitality, manufacturing, transportation, and water and wastewater markets. We also have several operating companies that focus on commercial fire protection. They provide integrated life safety solutions, including fire detection and suppression systems, and the most advanced security technology available today. The ECS headquarters team provides key support for its electrical and mechanical companies, including finance and accounting, human resources, legal, national purchasing and information technology.

Job Summary

EMCOR Construction Services, Inc. (ECS) seeks Regional Mechanical Operations Director. The  Regional Mechanical Operations Director supports operating companies (OPCOs) within the mechanical segment by assisting in the coordination, visibility, and improvement of operational performance.

The individual will work closely with the Chief Operations Officer and OPCO leadership teams to strengthen execution discipline, support leadership transitions, and improve operational predictability—without taking control of local operations.
The role is grounded in the company’s philosophy:
Operating companies are led locally.
The segment supports, aligns, and strengthens performance.
ECS HQ is based out of McLean, Virginia. However, candidates in other locations and meeting the requirements below may be considered.
Compensation Range:   $200,000 - $250,000
This position is bonus eligible.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
- OpCo Operational Support: - Assist SVP Operations in supporting OPCO performance across assigned region
- Participate in operating reviews and project discussions
- Help identify execution risks and improvement opportunities
- Support implementation of operational discipline (project controls, productivity, planning)
- Travel up to 40-60%

- Performance Visibility & Coordination: - Develop familiarity with key projects, backlog, and operational drivers across OPCOs
- Track performance indicators such as:
- Project execution trends
- Productivity signals
- Schedule adherence
- Provide structured updates to SVP Operations

- Leadership Support & Development: - Build relationships with OPCO leadership teams
- Support new CEO or operations leader transitions
- Assist Strategic Development Leader in onboarding alignment
- Learn how to coach and influence without authority

- Enterprise Initiative Support - Assist in coordinating enterprise initiatives including:
- Preconstruction discipline improvements
- Procurement strategies
- Project execution enhancements
- Technology and AI adoption
- Help translate enterprise initiatives into practical OPCO actions

- Acquisition & Integration Exposure: - Support SVP Operations in acquisition integration efforts
- Assist in understanding operational maturity of new businesses
- Learn integration frameworks and expectations

- Professional Development Expectations: - Exposure to multiple OPCO business models
- Participation in leadership decision-making
- Coaching from Operations Leadership
- Increasing responsibility in operational reviews and supp ort

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, the individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Position Requirements/Preferred Education and Experience

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction or related areas of study or field experience; and minimum of 7-10 years Mechanical Construction experience. Prior experience in one or more: Project Management, Field Operations, Estimating/Preconstruction, Fabrication/Prefabrication. Experience must include:

- Exposure to multiple project types preferred (commercial, industrial, mission critical).
- Broad understanding of Mechanical Contracting business.
- Proven track record of leading projects while maintaining a commitment to Ethics and Safety.

Computer Skills
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office Applications.
- Experience with Accubid, Procore, Bluebeam or other construction software.
- Familiarity with construction/financial software packages.

Language Skills

Must have the demonstrated ability to effectively communicate in English, cooperate, and collaborate with multiple levels of customers, employees, unions, government agencies, vendors and suppliers, and other contractor organizations.

jobs.description:
Operations Manager (NARA I)

About Us

When military bases, national security agencies, federal buildings, healthcare facilities, and leading commercial clients in Washington D.C and across the nation need superior facility support services, we answer the call. We offer a unique combination of government experience and facilities expertise that has helped us earn a position as one of the country’s leading integrated service providers.

Job Summary

EMCOR Government is seeking a talented Operations Manager to lead our facilities maintenance and operations support services contract for the National Archives and Records Administration in Washington, DC (NARA I). This position is considered key personnel and responsible for all contract operations. This position requires strong leadership, organizational, supervisory, and communication skills plus the understanding of numerous mechanical and structural systems (High-pressure steam boilers, chillers, central plants, HVAC, electrical, fire systems, plumbing, structural, carpentry etc.).  Custodial, NARA warehouse and audio/visual operations are also included.

The Operations Manager will also oversee several strategic subcontractors (high voltage, snow/grounds, generators, transportation, pest management, etc.).
The selected candidate will be located primarily at NARA I and will be required to travel periodically between NARA I and NARA II (College Park, MD), based on 24/7/365 mission needs.

Reporting:  This position reports directly to program management.

Supervision:  This position will directly supervise the Chief Operating Engineers, Leads/Foreman, Trades, Watch standers, Warehouse Manager, Audio/Visual Manager, Custodial Supervisors, etc.  This position will directly manage subcontractors for core services and IDIQ projects, as well as consultants.

#egs
#LI-JC1

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Leadership and Management
- Provides leadership, direction, and oversight of day-to-day activities like preventive maintenance scheduling, IDIQ preparation and scheduling, vendor visits, etc.
- Knowledge of building systems to include boiler/chiller, HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical, Security, Fire system, building automation, etc.
- Meets with building manager daily to discuss on-going issues and/or future plans.
- Monitors P&L and participates in the annual budget planning ad reforecasts.
- Provides trend analysis on O&M, safety, quality, and overall contract performance.
- Trains, mentors, and develops subordinates in preparation for increased responsibility and potential advancement.
- Creates reports and presentations and briefs company and customer leadership.
- Ensures staff are trained, licensed, and qualified to perform contract operations.
- Administers multiple collective bargaining agreements within daily operations.
- Manages custodial operations and campus grounds beautification.

IDIQ Planning and Cost Estimating
- Prepares the scope of work for various types of construction or repair projects.
- Prepares detailed cost estimates using RS Means or an equivalent cost estimating software. Must be able to articulate and justify cost and technical methodologies.
- Develop selection/options for most economical systems/approach to be utilized in preparation of bid packages.
- Solicits competitive bids and prepares estimates that are formally submitted to EMCOR senior leadership and the client representative for approval.
- Provides thoughtful, itemized, and detailed estimate/technical proposal for client evaluation.
- Formally present prepared estimates and other project deliverables to management and other project stakeholders.
- Prepares equipment and material submittals for client approval as specified.
- Plan, estimate, and schedule all types of work requests including complex electrical, mechanical, control systems, and structural work.
- Performs cost comparisons for repair vs. replacement.
- Prepare complete plans (e.g., existing and proposed) and method of execution for all IDIQ work requests
- Ability to read and understand as-builts, architectural, electrical, plumbing and mechanical drawings.
- Ability to read and understand manufacturer’s submittals and literature.
- Performs quality assurance on subcontractor performance, ensures compliance and acceptable services were performed, prepares invoices upon completion of all IDIQ projects to ensure timely accounts receivable receipts.
- Prepares a punch list and Quality Assurance inspection at the completion of all projects and ensures that all work is completed as per specifications and in a professional manner.
- Prepares and submits Request for Information (RFI) to the client as necessary.
- Attends and presents at Government meetings.

IDIQ Project Management
- Collaborates with site/HQ procurement, contracting departments and Center of Excellence for competitive bids, site walks, submittal packages, awards, etc.
- Directs subcontractors, monitors, and reports IDIQ progress/status updates to senior management and NARA facilities’ staff.
- Receives submittals, maintains NARA technical reference library.
- Collaborates with site/HQ for asset intake and management. Responsible for IDIQ project’s new/replacement assets and information (i.e., warranty, S/N, job plans, specifications, etc.) is accurate in Maximo (Computerized Maintenance Management System).
- Creates presentations/spreadsheets to manage, track and brief progress to senior program management and NARA senior leadership.

Qualifications

- Must have a minimum of seven (7) years of experience supervising 5 or more managers/departments and operations in a complex and dynamic environment.
- Must have a minimum of five (5) years of experience in IDIQ management, MEP planning and estimating structural, electrical, and mechanical IDIQ projects in a large facility or multiple facilities with highly complex mechanical, electrical, and structural requirements.
- An associates degree/bachelor’s degree in engineering, project management, construction or related field is required or a combination of education, experience, professional licensing/certification may be acceptable.
- Experience with RS Means cost estimating software or other “equal” cost estimating software that is widely recognized within the facilities maintenance and construction industries is desired.
- Proficiency with AutoCAD is highly desired.
- Proficiency with Maximo is highly desired.
- Must have excellent communication and listening skills and the ability to communicate with various levels within the organization.
- Must demonstrate and extremely high level of attention to detail and the ability to take initiative and adapt quickly to changing requirements.
- Must possess the ability to work under the pressure of multiple deadlines, managing and coordinating multiple projects, sometimes during off-hours.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Project and/or Smartsheet desired.
- Formal presentation/briefing skills are required.
- Must possess and consistently demonstrate a Mission First, People Always mindset.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle; or feel; reach with hands and arms; talks or hear and test or smell. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

jobs.description:
Continuous Improvement Engineer

Job Locations

US-OH-Cincinnati

ID

2026-52091

EMCOR Facilities Services, Inc.

Category

Shared Services

Position Type

Full-Time

Location Type

Remote

Posted Date

1 month ago (8/26/2026 5:10 PM)

About Us

From commercial office space and manufacturing to multi-site retail portfolios, we manage and support over 1 billion square feet of facilities space for the nation’s leading organizations. We provide comprehensive facility services ranging from mechanical maintenance and self-performed, site-based operations to energy-efficiency upgrades and supplier-managed interior/exterior maintenance.

Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive and analytical Continuous Improvement Engineer to drive operational standards and improvement, data-driven decision-making, and reliability-centered maintenance initiatives within a dynamic Integrated Facilities Management environment.
This Engineer-level role is focused on transforming operational data into meaningful insights, clear visualizations, and actionable recommendations and projects. The position applies continuous improvement principles, data storytelling, CMMS analytics, Lean/Six Sigma concepts, and foundational reliability practices to identify trends, improve maintenance performance, support process standardization and efficiencies, and help account teams make informed business decisions.
The Continuous Improvement Engineer partners with operations, maintenance teams, account leadership, vendors, and client stakeholders to analyze work orders, asset information and history, vendors, PMs, financial, and KPI data, and processes/workflows. This role is ideal for an individual with 3–8 years of experience who can connect data to operational outcomes, communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, and drive improvement initiatives that reduce waste, improve asset performance, create efficiencies and strengthen customer value.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Operational Analytics & Data Storytelling
·  Analyze work order, asset, PM, vendor, SLA, financial, and operational data to identify trends, risks, outliers, and improvement opportunities.
·  Develop clear dashboards, scorecards, summaries, and visual stories that translate complex data into actionable insights.
·  Present findings in a concise, compelling format for operations, account teams, leadership, and client stakeholders.
·  Own and execute projects associated with the above.

Continuous Improvement & Process Optimization
·  Support Lean and continuous improvement initiatives by identifying process gaps, workflow inefficiencies, recurring issues, and opportunities for standardization.
·  Assist in developing improvement plans, tracking progress, validating results, and communicating outcomes.
·  Help convert lessons learned into repeatable processes, tools, and reporting approaches.
·  Execute actions associated with the above including developing and executing training materials

Reliability & Maintenance Performance Support
·  Evaluate asset performance, PM effectiveness, reactive work trends, repeat failures, emergency work volume, high repair costs and bad actor assets.
·  Support PM reviews, failure trend analysis (Execute Root Cause Analysis), maintenance optimization, and repair-versus-replace recommendations.
·  Facilitate alignment between account teams, clients, and internal stakeholders to maintain data quality, process compliance, and audit readiness.
·  Apply foundational reliability principles to improve asset performance and maintenance decision-making including an annual Cap Ex planning report identifying and prioritizing replacement recommendations based on Customer and EMCOR criteria

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Communication
·  Partner with operations, maintenance, account leadership, vendors, finance, procurement, technology, and client stakeholders.
·  Align data insights with business needs and operational priorities.
·  Communicate analytical findings in plain language to both technical and non-technical audiences.
·  Own and execute improvement actions and projects.

Reporting, KPI Development & Business Reviews
·  Support development, maintenance, and improvement of KPI results, reporting, operational scorecards, business review materials, and account-level performance summaries.
·  Help ensure reporting is accurate, consistent, visually clear, and tied to operational priorities.
·  Own and execute improvement actions and projects to drive improved data integrity and execution results.

Additional Responsibilities & Operational Support
·  Perform other duties as deemed necessary by Operations and CI&R leadership, including support for special projects, account initiatives, data validation efforts, and continuous improvement activities.

Qualifications

Education
(HS Diploma, Under/Graduate Degree, etc.)
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Operations Management, Facilities Management, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education, technical training, and practical experience.

Business Experience
(prior years’ work/related experience)
• 3–8 years of experience in continuous improvement, operational analytics, facilities management, maintenance operations, reliability, manufacturing, engineering support, business intelligence, or a related environment.
• Experience analyzing operational or maintenance-related data and converting findings into recommendations.
• Experience supporting process improvement, KPI reporting, dashboard development, or performance management activities.
• CMMS platform experience preferred; Corrigo, Maximo, FEXA, or similar system experience is desirable.
• Maintenance or facilities operations experience preferred, but not required if the candidate has strong data analytics and continuous improvement experience.

Licenses/Certifications
Must possess a valid driver’s license. Certified Reliability Leader preferred, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt preferred; ability to achieve Green Belt certification within 12 months preferred.

Language Skills
Strong written and verbal command of the English language required. Must be able to communicate technical and analytical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Technical Qualifications & Skills
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, formulas, data cleanup, Power Query, and trend analysis.
• Experience with Power BI or similar visualization tools required or strongly preferred.
• Ability to develop dashboards, scorecards, charts, and business summaries that support data storytelling.
• Experience working with CMMS, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft Power Platform tools preferred.
• Ability to interpret operational data, identify patterns, and communicate meaningful insights.
• Strong interpersonal, organizational, time management, and self-management skills.
• Proactive and able to work independently while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
• Strong attention to detail, data accuracy, spelling, grammar, and proofreading.
• Customer-focused mindset with the ability to support internal and external stakeholder needs.

Physical Demands

- The employee may occasionally be required to walk commercial properties, maintenance areas, construction areas, mechanical spaces, or customer sites. The employee may occasionally climb stairs, access equipment areas, review asset locations, or participate in site walks. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move items up to 25 pounds.
- Most physical demands are limited to desk-based computer work, meetings, site walks, and business travel.

Work Environment

- The majority of work is performed in a standard office, remote, or hybrid work environment. The employee may also occasionally work in customer facilities, commercial properties, industrial environments, maintenance areas, or active job sites.
- While visiting operational sites, the employee may be exposed to moving mechanical parts, outdoor weather conditions, noise, mechanical rooms, electrical areas, construction activity, or other facility-related environments. Personal protective equipment may be required based on site conditions, including safety shoes, hard hat, eye protection, hearing protection, or other required PPE.
- The employee must follow all applicable safety requirements, customer site requirements, OSHA guidelines, and company policies. Travel is business-driven and may vary based on assigned projects, account needs, and leadership direction. Suggested travel expectation for this role is approximately 10%–25%, depending on project assignments and account support needs.

About Us

Dynalectric Arizona offers a comprehensive range of electrical solutions. Our expertise spans planning, construction, installation, and integration of some of the most advanced electrical, controls, and telecommunications systems.

Job Summary

Offering multidisciplinary electrical solutions under one roof, we have helped plan, construct, install, and integrate some of the most advanced electrical, controls, and telecommunications systems. We are looking for talented, motivated electrical and construction professionals to join our team.
For more information, please visit https://dyna-az.com
Job Title: Director of Operations - Mission Critical - Mesa, Arizona

#dynaz

Job purpose
The DOMC is responsible for managing and staffing the mission critical division appropriately including estimates, schedules, cost and quality of Dynalectric projects. This includes the planning and coordination of all aspects of the construction process, including field supervision management/coordination, hiring subcontractors, implementing cost control measures and internal reporting to provide excellent internal/external customer service.

Objective
The objective of this position is to maintain and execute current mission critical work, sustain, and grow customer base and overall operations of mission critical, and to grow the mission critical market sector.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

- Manage and focus on project revenue between $5M to $80M with a team of 15 - 30 employees.
- Plan, staff, and supervise all division activities including personnel administration, performance management, responsibilities, functions, etc.
- Participate in estimate close-out and proposal creation. Create an estimate threshold with new customer/GC above which estimates must be closed out with AZDM. Review all tabs in Accubid and cover the questions in the bid analysis form, assess current backlog and apply proper mark- up.
- Guide the WIP reports process for the department. Sit down with each PM as they do their WIP to assess their understanding of the information.
- Assess workloads of PM’s, Project Engineers, Project Coordinators, and Project Admins by monitoring bid logs, committed logs, under billings, work hours, general well-being, and verbal check ins.
- Schedule project kick-off & project close-out meetings to follow Dynalectric process.
- Use Estimating Log for reporting.
- Recommend cost-reduction initiatives while maintaining productivity and quality.
- Provide field teams and supervision with the proper information and support throughout the duration of the project.
- Actively participate in manpower dispatching/coordination with department management & field leadership.
- Review and evaluate present and future opportunities, current and future strengths and weaknesses specific to mission critical opportunities and hard trends within the industry.
- Request and select proposals from subcontractors, including contract negotiations.
- Participate in contract review .  Review for scope/accuracy and work with Contracts department to process.
- Work with Training Manager to ensure all relevant training is in compliance (ask questions during quarterly performance check-ups to address training. Check in with training manager to review training records of employees.)
- Ensure adherence to company health and safety standards (communicate with site safety professional/superintendent, report issues as needed to corporate Safety Director or General Superintendent)
- Ensure company policies and processes are being followed within the division (introduce and roll out standardization for estimating and document control, review process flow charts with team, and ensure the flow charts are being followed).
- Execute company HR processes (participate in semi-annual reviews coaching/counseling feedback)
- Attend internal Dynalectric meetings (Prefab, QA/QC, Safety, monthly department meetings)
- Keep ADM, COO, CFO, and CEO updated on personnel and the financial performance of the division.
- Work closely with the AZ General Operations Superintendent to ensure adequate field leadership and staffing is in place, Dynalectric company field standards, craftmanship and best practices are being met.
- Participate in job walks with Project Management, field supervision and Operations Superintendent to identify challenges and areas of improvement.

Qualifications

- At least 10 years of experience as a project manager within the electrical industry or a minimum of 10 years as a GF or Field Superintendent.
- Must have 10 years of estimating experience in the electrical industry.
- BSc/BA in construction management or related discipline preferred.
- Prior experience in managing project teams and assigning team members based on their experience and needs of the project.
- In-depth understanding of electrical construction and materials.
- Proficiency or knowledge of estimating software - Accubid preferred.
- Proficiency with MS Office Suite - especially Excel.
- Proficiency with Bluebeam preferred.
- Outstanding written & verbal communication skills.
- Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
- Must have valid driver license/insurance and reliable transportation.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a Director of Operations - Mission Critical to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
The DOMC is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

Both field and office based. Typical working hours for a DOMC may vary. Generally, Monday – Friday during normal business hours, but when deadlines approach, they may be asked to work longer hours. Some travel may be required for training/continuing education.
While performing the duties of this job, the DOMC may be exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration; may be exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at construction job sites (weather, noise, etc.).

Direct Reports
The DOMC may oversee Project Managers, Assistant Project Managers, Project Engineers, Estimators, and Project Coordinators. The DOMC may also work with Operation Superintendent, General Foreman, and Site Superintendents.

About Us

We are a full-service HVAC, building automation, chiller, and retrofit contractor with a reputation for combining high-quality consulting services with customized energy solutions. Our integrated, single-source solutions include turnkey in-house capabilities with design assistance, as well as engineering applications and automated control systems.

Job Summary

The Director of Operations will have overall responsibility for the direction and coordination of the organization upon Management team buy-in and approval. This role will align management team objectives, ensuring that all managers, consequently all departments, share a common goal, direction and vision. This position is required to implement and drive overall strategic initiatives, to safeguard and augment the efficiency of the branch’s operations, and to facilitate accelerating development and long term, sustainable success.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

- Organize, observe, and oversee the implementation of daily operations of the entire business, including Service, Retrofit, Automation, Sales, and Warehouse.
- Observations and recommendations to be taken to the Management team to initiate a platform for collective discussion, obtaining collective ideas for areas of improvement and ways to implement said areas.
- Upon agreement and buy-in from the Management Team, the Director of Operations will take the lead in driving such changes and modifications with the help of the Department Managers in enforcing such changes and modifications

- Ensure business is well coordinated and productive by managing its procedures and assisting department managers in coaching people.
- Recruiting and talent acquisition for all areas of the business. Collaborate with department managers and proactively identify future hiring needs.
- Evaluate process and procedures in all areas of the business and the overall efficiency of business according to organizational objectives and deliver improvement recommendations to management team
- Work with Department managers to implement processes and procedures to ensure timeliness, efficiency of product and deliverables, profitability and overall customer satisfaction.
- Cultivate positivity and a culture of teamwork.
- Conduit of communication and Liaison between department managers and key department personnel to make decisions for operational activities and set strategic goals.
- Oversee, plan and monitor the day-to-day running of business operations to ensure smooth progress, but avoid getting into the weeds on any issue. Focus on working on the business and not in the business.
- Work with Department Managers to create a one- and three-year business plan. Small plans for each department, and one full business plan for the branch that detail the department’s current position and plans for future growth.
- Observe staff from all departments and provide constructive feedback to departments managers
- Responsible for emphasizing, driving and implementing a culture that is centered on the Customer Experience.
- Drive ideas and initiatives for growth, profitability and customer retention.
